hook: An open-source Devin you can run yourself

beats.say: OpenComputer is an open-source, self-hostable coding agent for teams. You mention it in a Slack thread, it works on its own computer, and the result lands as a pull request.
The whole stack runs on one VM. A gateway starts a Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode session, each isolated with rootless Podman and saved to a git-backed store.
It can run in your own AWS, Google Cloud or Azure account, and the team says it opens pull requests 3.3 times faster than Devin in its benchmark.
